title: 谁都有办法看好你的“病”
en: Anyone can find a way to cure your "illness"

ex.py: Wǒ míngtiān xiǎng qǐng jià yì tiān.
ex.en: I want to ask for a day off tomorrow.
These things cost fifty yuan in total.

ex.py: Wǒ de línjū shì yí wèi lǎoshī.

ex.hz: 他先去了北京，后来去了上海。
ex.py: Tā xiān qù le Běijīng, hòulái qù le Shànghǎi.
ex.en: He went to Beijing first and later to Shanghai.

ex.hz: 我的爱好是看书和游泳。
ex.py: Wǒ de àihào shì kàn shū hé yóu yǒng.
ex.en: My hobbies are reading and swimming.

ex.py: Wǒ xiǎng bu chū hǎo bànfǎ.
ex.en: I can't think of a good way.

ex.py: Wǒ chī bǎo le, bù xiǎng zài chī le.
ex.en: I'm full and don't want to eat any more.

words.en: for the sake of; in order to

ex.hz: 为了学好汉语，他每天都练习。
ex.py: Wèile xuéhǎo Hànyǔ, tā měi tiān dōu liànxí.
ex.en: To learn Chinese well, he practises every day.

ex.hz: 我决定明年去中国学习。
ex.py: Wǒ juédìng míngnián qù Zhōngguó xuéxí.
ex.en: I've decided to study in China next year.
Winter in Beijing is very cold.

ex.hz: 上课的时候必须关手机。
ex.py: Shàng kè de shíhou bìxū guān shǒujī.
ex.en: You must turn off your phone during class.

ex.hz: 我们根据明天的天气决定去不去。
ex.py: Wǒmen gēnjù míngtiān de tiānqì juédìng qù bu qù.
ex.en: We'll decide whether to go based on tomorrow's weather.

ex.py: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ jiā de qíngkuàng.
ex.en: Please tell me about your family situation.

ex.hz: 请张开口，我看看你的牙。
ex.py: Qǐng zhāngkāi kǒu, wǒ kànkan nǐ de yá.
ex.en: Please open your mouth and let me look at your teeth.

ex.hz: 跑了一个小时，我渴极了。
ex.py: Pǎo le yí ge xiǎoshí, wǒ kě jí le.
ex.en: After running for an hour I was extremely thirsty.

lines.hz: 我最近睡不好，不太舒服，想请一天假去医院。
lines.py: Wǒ zuìjìn shuì bu hǎo, bú tài shūfu, xiǎng qǐng yì tiān jià qù yīyuàn.
lines.en: I haven't been sleeping well and don't feel well; I'd like a day off to go to the hospital.

lines.py: Nǐ yǒu jǐ tiān méi shuì hǎo le?
lines.en: How many days has it been since you slept well?

lines.hz: 差不多一个星期了，我没有办法睡着。
lines.py: Chàbuduō yí ge xīngqī le, wǒ méiyǒu bànfǎ shuìzháo.
lines.en: Nearly a week; I can't fall asleep.

lines.hz: 那你应该休息休息，明天我帮你请假。
lines.py: Nà nǐ yīnggāi xiūxi xiūxi, míngtiān wǒ bāng nǐ qǐng jià.
lines.en: Then you should get some rest; I'll ask for leave for you tomorrow.

lines.hz: 我什么运动都喜欢，冬天去爬山，夏天去游泳。
lines.py: Wǒ shénme yùndòng dōu xǐhuan, dōngtiān qù pá shān, xiàtiān qù yóu yǒng.
lines.en: I like all sports: hiking in winter, swimming in summer.

lines.hz: 我也想多运动，你觉得我应该选择什么？
lines.py: Wǒ yě xiǎng duō yùndòng, nǐ juéde wǒ yīnggāi xuǎnzé shénme?
lines.en: I want to exercise more too. What do you think I should choose?

lines.hz: 你可以跟我去游泳，游泳对身体很好。
lines.py: Nǐ kěyǐ gēn wǒ qù yóu yǒng, yóu yǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
lines.en: You can come swimming with me; swimming is very good for you.

questions.q: What does B do in summer?

grammar.en: ABAB: a short or tentative action, e.g. 休息休息

drills.en: You're too tired; you should get some rest.

drills.q: 我的作业写完了，你帮我___吧。
drills.en: I've finished my homework; please check it for me.
He's a new classmate; introduce him around.
Tomorrow let's go to the park and get some exercise.
This book is good; study it a bit too.

drills.q: 你对他不太了解，可以去___他。
drills.en: You don't know him well; go and get to know him.

grammar.en: question word + 都: every … without exception

drills.en: It's so late that nobody wants to go out.
At the weekend I don't want to do anything.

drills.q: 这个地方很漂亮，___都可以拍照。
drills.en: This place is beautiful; you can take photos anywhere.
You can eat whatever you want; it's my treat.

drills.q: 这个问题太容易了，___都会做。
drills.en: This question is so easy that anyone can do it.

drills.q: 我们___去都可以，只要不太晚。
drills.en: We can go any way you like, as long as it's not too late.

lines: 我病了，昨天请了一天假。
五个，我们一家人都来了。
dialogs.q: 女的家一共来了几个人？

lines: 我什么运动都喜欢，最喜欢游泳。

judge.text: 为了身体健康，他决定每天早上跑步。
我的邻居在大学工作，我们关系很好。
冬天的北京很冷，所以我们不去爬山了。
这次旅游一共花了三千块，比我想的多一点儿。
judge.claim: 这次旅游花的钱比他想的多。

replies.q: 你决定去哪儿旅游了吗？
